matched.note: Both name the identical defect: GitRevParse is exported yet has no production caller (test-only export in internal/acdsl/git.go); severity differs (run MAJOR vs golden INFO).

falsePositives.reason: Alleges no code defect: the added .serena/ and .DS_Store exclusions in filter_untracked are intentional tooling-dropping filters (Serena cache, Finder metadata — never session work), so the remove-safety count stays correct; the claim's only substance is a missing paper trail, a provenance/process observation the golden's own rulings (e.g. correctness-INF-1/INF-2) treat as a non-defect.

Not a defect: the git init -b main on an existing repo-less directory is the plan-backed C19 behavior (repos.go:582-584 comment), is guarded (dir exists AND no .git), and git init is non-destructive/reversible (creates only .git, touches no existing files); the 'unconditional side effect, no confirmation' framing with a fix of merely 'add a UI note' identifies intended behavior, not a code defect — and misses the actual cataloged defects here (GV3-008 stray-.git ordering, GV3-194 spec deviation).

Identifies no concrete, verifiable defect: it names no mistranslation and no missing entry, only a subjective impression that German catalog entries 'mix straight sentence punctuation with the more terse existing entries', self-admits it 'is not mechanically checkable', and recommends a human proofreading pass — a vague prose-taste observation, not a code defect (contrast the golden's concrete i18n defect GV4-208, a missing germanCatalog permissions entry).

uncataloged.reason: Genuine in-range observation not cataloged under this root cause: presentationStore is otherwise root-injected (path/stylePath) yet saveProfileSelection hardcodes a repo-relative read filepath.Join("settings","claude_code","presentation-profile.de.md") that silently falls back to an empty body on any CWD != repo-root (corroborated by GV3-071's 'body falls back to empty'), with internal/config/installenv.go carrying the same implicit contract; the golden catalogs the untested-coverage angle (GV3-071) but not this implicit-CWD-path-contract angle.
